# Experience Matters
With a career spent in executive local government agency finance and human resources roles, Allison brings the knowledge and steady leadership our water district needs. Her experience will ensure thoughtful decisions that protect our water today and for generations to come, while providing the workforce with the resources they need to fulfill Contra Costa Water District's (CCWD) mission of delivering reliable, high-quality water at the lowest cost in an environmentally responsible manner.
## Meet Allison
##### For more than 40 years, public service has been my passion. I’ve led local public agencies, managed millions in public resources, built strong teams, and worked to ensure our communities receive the reliable services they deserve. I’m bringing that experience to Contra Costa Water District because I know what it takes to lead with integrity, make responsible decisions, and deliver results. Our ratepayers deserve a Board member who is experienced, accountable, and ready to get to work—and that is the leadership I offer.
SEE ALLISON'S EXPERIENCE
###### — Allison Picard
